definitions.gloss: to come to mind; to recall; to hit upon a thought
definitions.explanation: To suddenly think of something relevant, often a cause, reason, or connection. Frequently used when reflecting on a situation and realizing something that fits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{思|おも}い{当|あ}たること⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{思|おも}い{当|あ}たる⟦{節|ふし}→節：03713_fushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have an idea of what the cause might be.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{思|おも}い{当|あ}たるもの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I can't think of any reason why his attitude changed.

notes:
Used when something relevant comes to mind, especially a cause, reason, or explanation. Often appears in investigative or reflective contexts — a doctor asking a patient, a detective asking a witness, or someone trying to figure out why something happened.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{当|あ}たる⟦{節|ふし}→節：03713_fushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have an inkling, to have a hunch about something
- {思|おも}い{当|あ}たること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no idea, nothing comes to mind
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{思|おも}い{当|あ}たること⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧?: can you think of anything?

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}いつく: to come up with, to think of — broader usage, includes creative ideas and inventions
- ⟦{心当|こころあ}たり→心当たり：15534_kokoroatari⟧: a clue, an idea (noun) — the noun form of a similar concept

COMMON PATTERNS:
Intransitive verb. The thing that comes to mind is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or が.
